Shared by both Keycloak modes; API_KEY does not use it.
Validates against Keycloak's /introspect endpoint on every
request — immediate revocation, extra network round-trip.
Validates the JWT signature locally against Keycloak's JWK set
— no per-request call to Keycloak, revocation only on expiry.
No Keycloak involved — validates against API keys persisted
in the "security" DB schema. Intended for machine-to-machine
